label: Matched same-bearer actual exercise controls with circular and restored supply routes
definition: Matched.exercise uses one source bearer, one particular recipient, and separate operation, adoption and product role-events. Operation and adoption share the source bearer. Both Boolean worlds contain the source; only the actual true world contains the recipient, adoption and product. Every profile records source operation AND product as contributors to adoption, and adoption as contributor to product. The direct source-only alternative is absent, merely admitted, or actually exercised. Matched.outputExercise instead directs the exercised source-only alternative to the product. SourceBasis independently supplies only the operation; ExerciseBasis additionally permits the same adoption role as an independently supplied contribution without adding another event or being. The shared causality frame and existential-token adapter interpret distinct-bearer causal credit through existing actual contributor paths in the selected esse respect.
note: Finite structural controls, not an implemented divine intellect or a certificate of metaphysical possibility. The three profiles preserve exactly the occurrence and bearer functions and retain nonempty actual contribution relations and a populated alternative world. Direct exercise is contingent; necessary source existence does not make an available record actually exercised. Adoption is a role-event, not a separately stipulated substance or intrinsic actuality, but this typing does not prove its compatibility with strong simplicity. The additional ExerciseBasis seed is a rival stopping commitment, not a derived adequacy judgment. CausesIn, GivesAt and #312 reason-token assignments are explicit path-credit interpretations, not independently warranted bridges to real causation of esse. MovesIn, DependsForBeing and PriorSimply are empty unused fields, and no conclusion relies on their emptiness. Rational recognition, independently specified practical content, nondeviant guidance, actual adoption, metaphysical all-alternative scope and adequacy remain OPEN. See docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md#actual-productive-exercise-and-the-output-dependence-test-2026-11-24.
